In the standard chart, "Employees Other Dues" (2111102) fits. Set all three employee folders, or none to keep using the company-wide accounts above.

allowanceTypes.empty: No allowance types yet. Use "Add the usual types" or create your own.
allowanceTypes.name: Name
allowanceTypes.isHousingHint: This is the housing allowance (reported in the housing column of the wages file)
allowanceTypes.inGosiBaseHint: Counts in the social insurance (GOSI) contribution base
allowanceTypes.inEosbBaseHint: Counts in the end-of-service gratuity wage base

errors.DUPLICATE_CODE: A type with this code already exists.
errors.IN_USE: Active employees are still paid this allowance. Remove it from them first.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This allowance type was not found.
errors.generic: Could not save this allowance type.

payments.title: Pay salaries and dues
payments.subtitle: Pay what payroll and end-of-service left owed. Each payment lowers the debt it was recorded under and the bank by the same amount.

errors.NOTHING_TO_PAY: Nothing is left to pay here.
errors.OVER_PAYMENT: The amount is more than what is owed.
errors.BEFORE_SOURCE_DATE: The payment date is before the payroll run or termination date.
errors.CASH_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Choose an active bank or cash account.
errors.NO_OPEN_PERIOD: No open fiscal period covers this date.

documents.noSettledInvoices: Not set against any invoice: the whole amount stays on account.
documents.countNoVariance: Every line matched the books, so nothing was posted to the ledger.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who performed each operation, when, and what was recorded. Open a document number or view the event details.
audit.documentHistory: View all activity for this document
audit.snapshotNotice: Values below were saved at the time of the operation. Older events may not contain every field; document links open the current version.
audit.noChanges: No differences between the recorded values.
audit.noDetails: No additional details were saved for this operation.
audit.searchHint: Table search includes loaded document numbers. Use filters and Load more for older events. Times use your device time zone.

sellerProfile.title: Seller profile
sellerProfile.lockedHint: A certificate has already been issued for this profile. Most fields can no longer be changed here.
sellerProfile.incomplete: Before onboarding can start, fill in: {{fields}}
sellerProfile.saveError: Could not save the seller profile.

egsUnits.title: EGS devices
egsUnits.needsProfile: Complete the seller profile above before adding a device.
egsUnits.name: Name
egsUnits.createError: Could not create the EGS device.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.otpPlaceholder: The one-time code from the Fatoora portal
onboarding.requestError: The request failed before ZATCA could respond. Check the server configuration and try again.
onboarding.renewalChecksRequired: ZATCA requires compliance checks to complete renewal. Run the checks, then request the issuance certificate. Invoice submission for this unit is paused until both steps are complete.
onboarding.active: This device is active and issuing invoices.

hint.NEW: Enter the OTP from the Fatoora developer portal to request a compliance certificate.
hint.CSR_GENERATED: Enter the OTP from the Fatoora developer portal to request a compliance certificate.
hint.COMPLIANCE_CSID_ISSUED: The compliance certificate is issued. Run the compliance checks next — every required sample document is tried, and all must pass.
hint.COMPLIANCE_CHECKS_PASSED: All compliance checks passed. Request the production certificate to activate this device.
hint.default: Follow the steps below to onboard this device with ZATCA.

invoicePanel.title: ZATCA status
invoicePanel.noHistory: No detailed attempts have been recorded. History is retained for submissions made after this update.

qrSource.SIGNED: QR from the signed simplified invoice
qrSource.CLEARED: QR returned with the cleared invoice

invoicePanel.dataPreviewNotice: Data-reading test QR only — not ZATCA approved. It has no digital signature and does not prove invoice acceptance.
invoicePanel.dataPreviewFields: Contains only seller name, VAT number, timestamp, total and VAT total.
invoicePanel.qrUnavailable: No usable QR is available yet. Standard invoices need a matching QR from the clearance response.
invoicePanel.scanHint: Use a ZATCA-compatible reader. Reading a QR is separate from checking acceptance; the QR has no explicit Sandbox label.
invoicePanel.awaiting: This invoice is linked to an EGS unit and is awaiting processing. If it remains here, check the unit and retry.
invoicePanel.notLinked: This invoice is not linked to an issuing unit. No ZATCA submission is available.
invoicePanel.downloadError: The XML download failed. Please retry.
invoicePanel.sandboxSignatureInvalid: Local signature verification failed. Sandbox may return a fixed certificate that does not match the device key. This is neither acceptance nor rejection by ZATCA. Verify the key/certificate pair and test in Simulation with a device-bound certificate.
invoicePanel.signatureInvalid: The electronic signature is invalid. Verify the key, certificate and XML before resubmitting; this invoice is not accepted.
invoicePanel.queued: The request is queued. ZATCA has not accepted the invoice yet; follow its status here.
invoicePanel.sandboxSubmissionWarning: You can generate XML and QR files and send a Sandbox test request. Sandbox may reject submission because its test certificate has a fixed VAT number different from your company; the actual response will be shown. Generated files do not mean the invoice was accepted.
invoicePanel.sandboxSellerMismatch: Sandbox rejected submission because the seller VAT number does not match its fixed test certificate. Generating XML and a QR does not mean the invoice was accepted. Keep the invoice data intact; test company-specific invoices with a Simulation unit and its own certificate.
invoicePanel.sandboxCertificateHint: This unit uses Sandbox. Its current test certificate does not match the device key, so an invalid signature will not be sent. Keep this environment for testing; use a Simulation unit with a matching certificate to test the complete issuance flow.

compliance.testNotice: TEST DOCUMENT — not a production tax invoice.

environmentHint.sandbox: Sandbox uses sample API responses. A successful response or readable QR does not prove acceptance by ZATCA.
environmentHint.simulation: Simulation validates test documents before production. Onboarding requires a taxpayer Fatoora account and a Simulation OTP.
environmentHint.production: Production sends actual fiscal documents to ZATCA. Use the production account and OTP.

invoices.title: Invoice submissions
invoices.hint: Track sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes issued by this system. Open a document to download its XML and QR. This list does not import historical invoices from ZATCA.

submissionIssue.CERTIFICATE_KEY_MISMATCH: The unit certificate does not match its signing key. Configure a matching certificate before retrying.
submissionIssue.CERTIFICATE_INVALID: The unit certificate or key could not be read. Review the integration setup.
submissionIssue.CERTIFICATE_SELLER_MISMATCH: ZATCA rejected the current certificate because it does not match the seller VAT number. Configure credentials for this company before sending more documents. For company-specific Sandbox tests, use Simulation.
submissionIssue.CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED: The unit certificate has expired or is not valid yet.
submissionIssue.ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISSING: The server credential encryption key is not configured.
submissionIssue.CHAIN_BLOCKED: A previous invoice reserved the sequence but could not finish generation. Resolve its issue first; its sequence will not be skipped or reset.

issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_UNIT_NOT_READY: Complete issuing-unit onboarding in ZATCA settings before issuing the document.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_SUPPLY_DATE_REQUIRED: Enter the actual supply date for the standard tax invoice.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_SUPPLY_DATE_INVALID: The supply date is invalid; select a valid calendar date.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_SELLER_VAT_INVALID: Correct the seller VAT number in company settings: 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_BUYER_VAT_INVALID: Correct the customer VAT number: 15 digits, starting and ending with 3.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_SELLER_ADDRESS_INVALID: Complete the seller address: street, 4-digit building number, district, city, 5-digit postal code and country.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_BUYER_ADDRESS_INVALID: Complete the customer street, city and country; a Saudi address also requires a building number, district and 5-digit postal code.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_SELLER_CR_INVALID: Correct the seller commercial registration number to 10 digits.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_BUYER_CR_INVALID: Correct the customer commercial registration number to 10 digits.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_SELLER_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter the seller name in company settings.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_VOID_NOT_REJECTED: Only an invoice ZATCA rejected can be voided this way.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_VOID_SIMPLIFIED_UNSUPPORTED: Correcting a rejected simplified invoice is not supported yet. Contact support.
issueErrors.COMPLIANCE_BUYER_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter the customer name before issuing the invoice.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.subtitle: What a new installation still needs, in the order to do it. The required steps must be done before real work.
setup.readyHint: The required steps are done. The rest can wait until you need them.

ACCOUNT_MAPPINGS.title: Link the accounts
ACCOUNT_MAPPINGS.hint: Tell the system which accounts each kind of posting uses (inventory, receivables, payables, VAT, payroll...). Nothing can be posted before this.

TAX_CODES.title: Add the tax codes
TAX_CODES.hint: The VAT rates used on invoices. One button adds the Saudi ones.

WAREHOUSE.title: Add the first warehouse
WAREHOUSE.hint: Stock lives in warehouses; you need one before receiving or selling stock.

FISCAL_YEAR.title: Open next year's fiscal year
FISCAL_YEAR.hint: The current year is created for you; add the next one before it ends.

ALLOWANCE_TYPES.title: Add the allowance types
ALLOWANCE_TYPES.hint: Housing, transport, food... only if you run payroll.

EMPLOYEE_FOLDERS.title: Set the employee account folders
EMPLOYEE_FOLDERS.hint: Each new employee then gets their own advance, salary and dues accounts. Optional.

WPS.title: Enter the wages-file (WPS) details
WPS.hint: Bank and establishment ids for the monthly wages file. Only if you run payroll.

APPROVAL_POLICY.title: Set the purchase approval limit
APPROVAL_POLICY.hint: Orders above it wait for approval. Without one nothing waits.

setup.suggestionsWarning: These are proposals read from the standard chart, not accounting rulings. Review each one, ideally with your accountant, and tick only what you agree with. Nothing is created or linked until you confirm.
setup.createUnder: Create the account "{{name}}" ({{code}}) inside the folder {{folder}}, and link it
setup.noSuggestions: No proposals: everything that can be proposed is already linked, or your chart is not the standard one. Link the rest by hand.

drafts.title: My drafts
drafts.subtitle: Your private working copies, saved on the server. They do not affect accounts or stock until posted.
drafts.error: Latest changes were not saved. Retry before leaving.
drafts.conflict: This draft changed or is no longer available. Reload to restore the saved version; older changes will not overwrite it.
drafts.confirmDiscard: Discard this draft? Posted documents will not be affected.
drafts.confirmDeleteAll: Delete all your saved drafts? Posted documents will not be affected.

trail.title: Track document
trail.subtitle: This document’s preceding and following documents, direct payments and journal entries, without expanding into other documents through a shared customer or payment.
trail.truncated: This chain is large; open a linked document to explore further relationships.
trail.activityHint: Recorded events for this document, with the user, time and change details.
trail.noActivity: No recorded activity for this document

errors.generic: Unable to post the return. Check the date, warehouse and account mappings, then retry.
errors.OVER_RETURN: Quantity exceeds the remaining returnable quantity. Refresh the invoice.
errors.INVALID_RETURN: Check the original invoice lines and return date.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough stock in the selected warehouse.
errors.CREDIT_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: Return value exceeds the invoice remaining after previous notes.
errors.DEBIT_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: Return value exceeds the invoice remaining after previous notes.
errors.NO_OPEN_PERIOD: No open fiscal period covers the return date.

returns.chooseWarehouse: Choose the warehouse receiving the goods
returns.purchaseHint: Create a purchase return from the original supplier invoice, then select quantities and the warehouse.

imports.title: Import {{kind}}
imports.hint: Upload XLSX (first worksheet) or CSV. Maximum 200 rows and 2 MB. Download the column template; preview does not save anything. Correct errors in your file and upload it again.
imports.kindsHint: Party kinds: CUSTOMER, SUPPLIER, CUSTOMER_SUPPLIER (both), COMPANY, PERSON, OTHER. Import employees through HR. Keep phone numbers and identifiers as text in Excel to preserve leading zeros.
imports.prepare: Prepare your file, then review the data
imports.fileLimits: XLSX (first worksheet) or CSV · Up to 200 rows · 2 MB
imports.partyTemplateHint: The template includes one row per kind. Complete the rows you need and delete unused rows. You can repeat a kind for multiple parties.
imports.textHint: Format phone numbers and identifiers as text in Excel to preserve leading zeros.
imports.previewHint: Preview does not save data. Review the results, correct errors in your file and upload it again before confirming the import.
imports.skipInvalid: Import only valid rows; skip the rows with errors

errors.FILE_LIMIT: File is too large or complex. Use a smaller workbook.
errors.ROW_LIMIT: Choose a file containing 1–200 data rows.
errors.INVALID_HEADERS: Column headings must be unique and non-empty. Use the template.
errors.INVALID_FILE: Cannot read this file. Choose a valid XLSX or CSV file.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Preview failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.COMMIT_FAILED: Save could not be confirmed. Review the refreshed preview and the list before retrying; existing records are flagged as duplicates.
errors.INVALID_DECIMAL: Use a non-negative decimal with at most four decimal places
errors.INVALID_KIND: Use CUSTOMER, SUPPLIER, CUSTOMER_SUPPLIER, COMPANY, PERSON or OTHER

replenishment.quantityError: Enter a positive quantity no greater than {{max}}, with up to four decimal places.
replenishment.title: Suggested purchase requests
replenishment.hint: Choose a warehouse, select items and review quantities. Creating a request submits it for review; it does not place an order or change stock. Up to 100 items per request.
replenishment.formula: Suggested quantity = reorder point − on-hand stock − pending/accepted requests − unreceived open orders, with a minimum of zero. Quantities may be reduced before submission.
replenishment.error: Unable to complete the operation. Quantities may have changed; refresh suggestions and review your selection.

emailHistory.title: Email history
emailHistory.hint: Accepted means the provider accepted the message; Delivered means the recipient server accepted it. Refresh delivery status for Resend. SMTP acceptance and Gmail drafts cannot confirm delivery. Unknown or stuck sending attempts require checking with the provider before sending again. Times are shown in Riyadh time.
emailHistory.error: Unable to load or refresh delivery status. A Resend key with email-read access is required to check delivery.

install.title: Install Markaz as an app
install.browserGuide: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen, if available. If Markaz is already installed, open it from your apps.
install.body: Open Markaz straight from your home screen or desktop, in its own window, and be ready for notifications later.
install.iosBody: Add Markaz to your home screen to open it like an app.
install.iosStepShare: Tap the Share button in the Safari toolbar.
install.iosStepAdd: Choose "Add to Home Screen", then tap Add.

offline.title: You are offline.
offline.body: You can keep reading the pages you opened before. Changes are turned off until the connection returns.
offline.blocked: You are offline. This action needs a connection, so nothing was saved. Try again when you are back online.
offline.notSaved: You are offline and this page was not opened before, so it is not available yet.

bots.title: Chat bots
bots.subtitle: Connect the system to Telegram or Discord: approvals with buttons, alerts, lookups, documents and scheduled reports.

setup.keyMissingBody: Set BOT_CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server (32 random bytes, base64) and restart. Bot tokens are never stored without it.
setup.publicUrlMissing: No public address is configured (BOTS_PUBLIC_API_URL). Telegram can still connect in polling mode; Discord needs a public HTTPS address.
setup.webAppUrlMissing: BOTS_WEB_APP_URL is not set, so messages will not include “Open in ERP” buttons.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.tagline: Private chats with buttons, files and scheduled reports.

discord.name: Discord
discord.tagline: Slash commands, coloured cards, pop-up forms and private replies.

comingSoon.name: WhatsApp · Slack · Teams
comingSoon.tagline: Planned. Each is one more adapter on the same design.

connect.title: Connect {{provider}}
connect.transportWebhookHelp: The platform calls this server directly. Needs the public HTTPS address.
connect.transportPollingHelp: This server asks Telegram for new messages. Works without a public address (on-premise).
connect.dataSharingTitle: Messages pass through the chat platform
connect.dataSharingBody: Everything the bot sends — amounts, customer names, documents — is carried by {{provider}}'s servers outside this deployment. Only enable it if your company accepts that.
connect.dataSharingAccept: I understand and accept this for my company
connect.approvalCeilingHelp: Purchase orders above this amount can only be approved in the system. Leave empty for no limit.
connect.approvalCeilingInvalid: Enter an amount such as 50000 or 50000.00.

telegram.step1: Open Telegram and start a chat with @BotFather.
telegram.step2: Send /newbot, choose a display name and a username ending in “bot”.
telegram.step3: BotFather replies with a token like 123456789:AA… — copy it.
telegram.step4: Optional: /setuserpic and /setdescription to brand the bot with your company.

discord.step1: Open discord.com/developers/applications and create a New Application.
discord.step2: General Information: copy the Application ID and the Public Key.
discord.step3: Bot: reset and copy the token. Keep the Message Content intent off — it is not needed.
discord.step4: Optional: enter your server's ID (Guild ID) so commands appear instantly in that server.
discord.step5: After saving, open the invite link shown here to add the bot to your server.

publicKey.label: Public key
publicKey.help: Developer Portal → General Information (64 hex characters)

guildId.label: Server (guild) ID — optional
guildId.help: Right-click your server with Developer Mode on → Copy Server ID

discord.manualEndpoint: Discord did not accept the address automatically. Paste the webhook address below into Developer Portal → General Information → Interactions Endpoint URL, then press “Re-register”.
discord.invite: Invite the bot to your server

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.hint: Approve or reject purchase orders with buttons.

alerts.label: Alerts
alerts.hint: Approval requests, low stock, ZATCA problems.

lookups.label: Lookups
lookups.hint: Customers, items, invoices and cash on demand.

documents.label: Documents
documents.hint: Invoice and statement PDFs sent as files.

receipts.label: Receipts
receipts.hint: Photos and PDFs attached to purchase records.

overview.webhookUrlHelp: The address the platform calls. It is set automatically when possible.

credentials.hint: Stored tokens are never shown. Type a new value only to replace one; empty fields keep what is stored.
credentials.saved: Credentials replaced and the bot was re-registered

users.empty: No one has linked a chat account yet. Users link their own account from “My chat bots”.
users.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? The user stops receiving messages until they link again.

groups.hint: Send /chatid in a group or channel where the bot is a member, then register that id here. Groups receive only the reports you choose — never approvals or lookups.
groups.title: Name

danger.disableHint: Stops all messages and ignores incoming taps. Links and settings are kept.
danger.deleteHint: Removes the bot's commands from the platform and deletes its credentials, links and history here. The audit log keeps the record.
danger.deleteConfirm: Delete this bot connection? This cannot be undone.

errors.CREDENTIALS_INVALID: Some credentials are missing or in the wrong format.
errors.TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED: This mode is not available for this platform.
errors.PUBLIC_URL_MISSING: Webhook mode needs BOTS_PUBLIC_API_URL on the server.
errors.PLATFORM_ERROR: The chat platform returned an error. Try again.

testReasons.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts — wait a minute
testReasons.BAD_REQUEST: The values do not belong together

mine.title: My chat bots
mine.subtitle: Link your Telegram or Discord account to get approvals, alerts and reports in chat.
mine.noBots: Your company has not connected a chat bot yet.
mine.codeTelegramHint: Press the button (or send the command below to the bot). The code works once, for 10 minutes.
mine.codeDiscordHint: In Discord, send this command to the bot. The code works once, for 10 minutes.
mine.unreachable: The bot cannot reach you — you may have blocked it. Open the chat and send /menu.

list.title: Fixed assets
list.subtitle: Every asset the company owns: what it cost, what is left of it, and where it is.
list.search: Search by number, name, serial or location
list.emptyHint: Add the company's first asset, or register assets it already owned with their opening balance.

form.newSubtitle: Saved as a draft. Nothing reaches the ledger until you capitalise it.
form.openingSubtitle: An asset the company owned before using this system, with the depreciation already taken on it. Posted straight to the ledger.
form.residualHint: Leave empty to use the category default ({{percent}}%).
form.lifeHint: Leave empty to use the category default ({{months}} months).
form.notDepreciable: Assets in this category (land, for example) are never depreciated.
form.openingHint: Depreciation taken on this asset up to the opening balance date. The rest of its value is spread over the days left in its life.
form.noCategories: No asset category yet. Create one first.
form.openingConfirm: This posts the asset to the ledger now: Dr asset account, Cr accumulated depreciation and opening balance equity. Continue?

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft asset? Its number will not be reused.
detail.draftNotice: This asset is a draft. Capitalise it to post its cost to the ledger and start depreciating it.
detail.fullyNotice: This asset is fully depreciated: its book value equals its residual value.

capitalize.title: Capitalise asset
capitalize.intro: Posts the asset cost to the ledger on its acquisition date. From then on its amounts are final.
capitalize.sourceHint: The bank, cash box, supplier account or assets-under-construction account the cost came from. Purchases with VAT go through a supplier invoice instead.

transfer.title: Transfer asset
transfer.intro: Changes where the asset is, who holds it, or the cost center its depreciation is charged to. No ledger entry.

dispose.title: Dispose of asset
dispose.intro: Takes the asset off the register. Depreciation is first brought up to the disposal date, then the remaining book value is booked as a loss.
dispose.irreversible: This posts to the ledger and cannot be undone.
dispose.salesNote: Selling an asset to a customer needs a tax invoice and is not available yet.

editInfo.title: Edit asset details
editInfo.intro: Only descriptive details can change once an asset is in the ledger.

categories.title: Asset categories
categories.subtitle: Each category sets an asset's default life, residual value, number prefix and ledger accounts.
categories.name: Name
categories.prefixHint: Assets in this category are numbered {{example}}.
categories.depreciableHint: Turn off for land and other assets that are never depreciated.
categories.assetAccountHint: An asset account with a debit balance. Debited with each asset cost.
categories.accumulatedAccountHint: A contra-asset account (type asset, credit balance). Credited with depreciation.
categories.expenseAccountHint: An expense account. Debited with each month of depreciation.
categories.locked: In the ledger: accounts and prefix are fixed
categories.emptyHint: Start with categories such as vehicles, furniture, computers and buildings.
categories.noContraAccounts: No contra-asset account (asset type with a credit balance) exists yet. Create one in the chart of accounts.

runs.title: Depreciation runs
runs.subtitle: One run per month posts that month's depreciation for every asset in service.
runs.previewEmpty: No asset has depreciation due for this month.
runs.catchUpNote: Lines marked catch-up cover days before this month, for assets added after earlier runs.
runs.postConfirm: Post {{amount}} of depreciation for {{period}}? It can only be undone by reversing the run.
runs.reverseHint: Posts a mirror entry on the same date and puts every asset back where this run found it.
runs.cannotReverse: Only the latest run can be reversed, and only while none of its assets has been disposed of.
runs.emptyHint: Run depreciation at the end of each month, after adding that month's assets.

reports.title: Fixed asset reports
reports.subtitle: The register at any date, movement over a period, and a check that the register agrees with the ledger.
reports.reconciled: The register agrees with the ledger.
reports.notReconciled: The register and the ledger differ. Look for manual journal entries on these accounts.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.CATEGORY_CODE_TAKEN: Another category already uses this code.
errors.PREFIX_TAKEN: Another category already uses this number prefix.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: Assets of this category are already in the ledger, so its accounts and prefix can no longer change.
errors.CATEGORY_INACTIVE: This category is inactive. Activate it or choose another.
errors.ASSET_ACCOUNT_INVALID: The asset account must be an active, postable asset account with a debit balance.
errors.ACCUMULATED_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Accumulated depreciation must be an active, postable asset account with a credit (contra) balance.
errors.EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Depreciation expense must be an active, postable expense account.
errors.ACCOUNTS_NOT_DISTINCT: The three accounts must all be different.
errors.DEPRECIABLE_NEEDS_ACCOUNTS: A depreciable category needs an accumulated depreciation account and a depreciation expense account.
errors.ASSET_NOT_DRAFT: This asset is already in the ledger and can no longer be edited this way.
errors.ASSET_NOT_IN_SERVICE: Only an asset in service can do this.
errors.SOURCE_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Choose an active postable account other than this category's own accounts.
errors.EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND: The selected employee was not found.
errors.COST_CENTER_NOT_FOUND: The selected cost center was not found or is inactive.
errors.SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND: The selected supplier was not found.
errors.IN_SERVICE_BEFORE_ACQUISITION: The in-service date cannot be before the acquisition date.
errors.NO_OPEN_PERIOD: No open fiscal period covers this date. Open the period first.
errors.RESIDUAL_EXCEEDS_COST: The residual value must be between zero and the cost.
errors.LIFE_REQUIRED: A depreciable asset needs a useful life.
errors.OPENING_EXCEEDS_DEPRECIABLE: Opening depreciation cannot exceed cost minus residual value.
errors.OPENING_AFTER_LIFE: The useful life had already ended at the opening date, so opening depreciation must equal cost minus residual value.
errors.OPENING_DATE_REQUIRED: Opening depreciation needs the date it is stated at.
errors.OPENING_ON_NON_DEPRECIABLE: This category does not depreciate, so it cannot carry opening depreciation.
errors.FUTURE_PERIOD: A month that has not started yet cannot be depreciated.
errors.RUN_EXISTS: This month has already been depreciated.
errors.RUN_BEFORE_LATEST: A later month has already been depreciated. Runs go forward in time.
errors.NOTHING_TO_DEPRECIATE: No asset has depreciation due for this month.
errors.RUN_NOT_FOUND: This depreciation run no longer exists.
errors.RUN_NOT_LATEST: Only the latest depreciation run can be reversed.
errors.RUN_ALREADY_REVERSED: This run has already been reversed.
errors.RUN_HAS_DISPOSED_ASSET: An asset in this run has changed since (for example, disposed of), so the run can no longer be reversed.
errors.DISPOSAL_BEFORE_DEPRECIATED: Depreciation is already posted past this date. Reverse that run first or choose a later date.
errors.DISPOSAL_BEFORE_ACQUISITION: The disposal date cannot be before the asset entered the ledger.
errors.MAPPING_MISSING: An account mapping this needs is not set. Set it in Settings > Account mapping.

panel.title: AI assistant
panel.subtitle: Ask, or let it do the work

mode.label: Mode
mode.reviewHint: Proposes changes; nothing is saved until you approve
mode.autoHint: Saves simple changes at once; risky ones still need your approval

welcome.title: How can I help?
welcome.ask: Ask about sales, balances, customers, employees or stock. I only read — I never change anything in this mode.
welcome.review: Tell me what to create. I will prepare each change as a card, and nothing is saved until you approve it.
welcome.auto: Simple records are saved right away. Anything risky still waits for your approval.

notConfigured.title: The assistant is not set up yet
notConfigured.body: An administrator needs to choose an AI provider and model.

composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Ctrl+J to open or close
composer.placeholder_ask: Ask about your numbers… (type / for commands)
composer.placeholder_review: Tell me what to create… I'll prepare it for your review
composer.placeholder_auto: Tell me what to do… simple changes save right away
composer.pageContextHint: The assistant knows which page you are on. Remove to ask without it.
composer.batchHint: {{count}} lines — one record per line will be proposed
composer.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (10 MB at most).
